summary: Verified all 5 reported bug fixes: (1) Backend preview_service_requested flag saves/returns end-to-end. (2) /api/upload multipart image endpoint works, images retrievable via /api/uploads/{id}. (3) Order items preserve color/size/quantity in POST and GET. (4) ProductDetail requires color+size selection - shows '* الرجاء الاختيار' hint and rejects add-to-cart with Arabic toasts until both selected. (5) Home hero uses new customer-assets image URL. (6) Checkout renders preview-service checkbox and saves preview_service_requested=true. (7) Admin order card shows '⭐ معاينة' badge in collapsed view and 'خدمة المعاينة مطلوبة' text when expanded. Full E2E flow verified: register->add-to-cart->checkout with preview checked->order appears in admin with badge+details. Admin image upload UI works (URL populated, success toast). Backend 33/33 pytest passing.

ui_bugs.issue: Label components are not linked to Input via htmlFor/id, so clicking the label doesn't focus the input and Playwright's get_by_label() cannot target them. Functional impact is minimal (typing still works when clicking the input directly), but this hurts accessibility and testability.

action_items: (Optional low-priority) Add id attribute to Checkout inputs (governorate, city) and link via <Label htmlFor=...> for accessibility & test targeting.

(Observation) Seeded product catalogue was reduced to 1 product (فستان البيونة) between iteration 1 and iteration 2 - the previous test added TEST_منتج via admin API to have variants for testing. Main agent may want to re-seed products for demo.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.js correctly initializes selectedColor='' and selectedSize='' (no auto-defaults), validates on add-to-cart, and shows red '* الرجاء الاختيار' hint - matches user requirement.
Checkout.js correctly wires preview_service_requested boolean into orderData payload sent to /api/orders.

server.py /api/upload stores base64 in MongoDB (uploaded_files collection) and GET /api/uploads/{id} returns bytes with correct Content-Type + Cache-Control. Uses admin-only guard (403 for non-admin, 401 for missing token).
AdminOrderCard.js correctly conditionally renders '⭐ معاينة' collapsed badge and 'خدمة المعاينة مطلوبة' expanded text based on order.preview_service_requested.
ProductManager.js correctly uses multipart POST to /api/upload with Bearer token and prepends REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for the returned relative URL.
models.py: Order & OrderCreate both include preview_service_requested: bool = False - default is safe.
Minor: base64 image data URLs in seeded products bloat the /api/products response - not a bug but a perf concern for future.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@waheebafashion.com / admin123. Test users generated per test with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_منتج product with خمري/M variant via admin API (needed because only 1 seeded product remained and it had no variants). Created multiple orders during E2E test with preview_service_requested=true.
